stem: How did W. E. B. Du Bois combat prejudice like that described in the excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: He demanded the passage of women's suffrage.

options.label: B
options.text: He established an early civil rights group.

options.label: C
options.text: He advocated making political compromises with segregationists.

options.label: D
options.text: He sought court orders to protect the rights of voters.

visual_elements:
After winning the right to participate in the American experiment of self-government, African Americans were systematically and ruthlessly excluded from it: From 1901 to 1929, there were no blacks in the federal legislature.

—"Black Americans in Congress: An Introduction," Historical Essays on the Black Americans in Congress, www.baic.house.gov (accessed March 29, 2011)
